note: The two records both packages emit. A log store holds them side by side for years, so the type strings and the JSON keys are an interface: an implementation may add an optional key without moving the version, and may not rename or re-mean one. `domain` and `emitter` are how a reader groups rows by organisation and by deployment; both are absent when there is nothing verified to put in them.

audit.correlation: callId is the same on both events of one call, and unique across calls.
